general_information: Recommendations from clinical experts and reports by the FDA and American Heart Association on the use of specific drugs and procedures for stroke prevention and treatment.
Discussion on the effectiveness of carotid endarterectomy versus stenting in preventing recurrent strokes.
Analysis of various clinical trials such as SAPPHIRE, CAVATAS, and others regarding treatment methods for symptomatic and asymptomatic carotid artery stenosis.

Information on the safety and effectiveness of specific medications and procedures such as selective COX-2 inhibitors, emboli protection during carotid stenting, and the use of nicotine for smoking cessation in clinical practice.
Meta-analyses and reviews on the risk-benefit profiles of carotid surgeries and medications in stroke prevention.
